## Assessment

Overfit. The strategy fails to capture meaningful edge on J's winner days (only 24.2% of maximum possible edge_capture: 181.84/342 on 4/29, 0/470 on 5/01, 191.64/730 on 5/04). The high wide_pnl ($40,656.65) is driven by non-J days (top 5 days likely non-J, constituting >95% of P&L), indicating regime-specific performance not aligned with J's structural edge. The strategy profits on loser J days by avoiding losses but fails to participate in winner days, suggesting it is optimized to non-trending/chop regimes rather than J's breakout structure.

### (2) Which knob changes drove improvement vs baseline?
Baseline unknown (stage1 keeper not provided). However, notable knob values: vol_mult=1.1 (slight volatility expansion filter), body_min_cents=0.02 (near-zero body tolerance allowing doji entries), min_stars=2 (low signal quality threshold), strike_offset=2 (OTM-2 strikes), premium_stop_pct=-0.06 (6% catastrophe cap), tp1_premium_pct=0.4 (conservative 40% TP1), runner_target_pct=3.0 (aggressive 300% runner target), profit_lock_threshold_pct=0.0 (profit lock disabled), proximity_dollars=1.5 (tight proximity to level), require_break_above_open=true (entry requires break above open). Without stage1 baseline, cannot isolate specific improvements; likely the combination of low min_stars and tight proximity increased trade frequency (234 trades) but degraded winner-day capture.
